label: Human Freeze Gate
description: Human-owned durable suspend gate. Pauses execution pending human approval (approve/reject). Mirrors the HumanApprovalRequired lifecycle state. The decision output is not tagged as a proposal — humans are authority actors, not model proposers.

inputs.name: context
inputs.description: Context shown to the reviewer (state, provenance, artifact summary)

inputs.name: provenance
inputs.description: Provenance record to present alongside the approval request

outputs.name: approved
outputs.description: True if the human approved; false if rejected. Not tagged — human decisions are authority acts.

outputs.name: approval_record
outputs.description: Signed approval record for provenance journaling.
